summary: Recorded the executed control in the question's account and moved attention to the authority-transition axis. The control receipt 9d07449105684a498113db891da025d9 (fixed experiment 242eaa8afa384a87b0952fbcd4b074b4-experiment, exit 0) replayed the identical crash pattern with the recovery driven by replica 2, which holds X at value ballot 0; both declared preservation comparisons hold, evaluating parsed indices 17 and 19-20, so the value loss is tied to the coordinator lacking the command rather than to the crash pattern - that counterevidence is now executed rather than sourced. The question's own discrimination is answered, so its disposition is set to explained (the interpretation stays violated/asserted with its four counterevidence items and four limits). An independent sourced question was opened on the recovery ballot/authority path: makeBallot fixes a replica's ballot at r.Id or r.Id+N and climbs above maxRecvBallot only while IsLeader is set, epaxos.New hardcodes IsLeader false and only the master's BeTheLeader RPC sets it, and all three nack repairs are gated on r.IsLeader while executeCommands re-enqueues the same instance every COMMIT_GRACE_PERIOD; three new source ranges were recorded for that path. Its probe (two consecutive non-designated recovery attempts versus an IsLeader-enabled attempt) is designed but not yet written.
